text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Baton passes from swimmer to 2nd runner! 
Leg 2 runners head to kitchen area for mission!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Unflavored sports drink powder is provided! 
Runners must mix in custom ingredients and seasonings, 
then deliver bottle to 3rd runner!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Found it~! Nutrition guide chart! Let's pick 
ingredients great for fatigue recovery, eii-mun~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Something soothing that clears exhaustion fast 
would be perfect. This mix looks neat~, 
soy milk and lemon—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Honey and lemon should suffice. Preparation won't take long...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My, so many intriguing ingredients! Which should 
I combine♪ Prunes, cinnamon... what is that one?

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega finishes drink mix and dashes toward 
3rd runner! Satono Diamond hot on her heels!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, so next... if I blend yogurt with this 
pudding, should be super great! And voila!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
At 2nd transition area, Leg 3 cyclists prepare! 
Leader Admire Vega coming into view!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Awa-wawa, Ayabe-san is in lead...! I-I must do my best... do my best...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*... Transition zone... in sight...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: *huff*, *puff*... Taaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Gh...! Not letting you pass! Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega and Satono Diamond sprint side by side! 
Closing distance in flash! Baton touch to 3rd runners!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin, Bakushiiin—!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O rockets forward on bicycle! 
Closing right in on Meisho Doto!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Ryan-san~! Sorry to keep you waiting, mun~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: No problem! Leave it to me! Just little further, keep fighting!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Leg 3 riders approach mountain midpoint! 
Path splits into 3 routes! Steep, brutal climb 
short-cut—

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Or long riverbed bypass around mountain? 
Leader Meisho Doto opts for balanced middle hill route!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto dismounts bike and removes helmet! 
Looks like she's drinking mix from 2nd runner!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: *gulp*, *gulp*... Phew! Sweet and yummy~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, goes down easy. Ah, if I squeeze bottle 
tightly, it comes out faster! ...Squeeze!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hwa-bwah?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: S-Spilled it everywhere... Ah, hands sticky with syrup now~...
*BZZZZ, BZZZZ—*

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: B-Bee?! Please stay away, Eeeeeek!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Owwch!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
*sob*, my bike... Eeek?! Chain fell 
off... it's broken, totally broken... *sniff*~!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O took long riverbed detour! 
Despite weak long-distance stamina, 
she picked longest route on course!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... Halfway mark reached... 
If stamina fades... just glide downhill...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
*gulp*...? This flavor... Sakura mochi?! My absolute 
favorite snack! Surging with full power now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
*huff*, *pant*... Slope gets steeper from here... 
Shortest route, but if pace drops uphill, 
I'll lose all advantage...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
*gulp*, *gulp*...! This is... drink recipe I suggested? 
Tastes light, crisp. Edamame, yogurt, lemon mix—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I see! Tannhauser-chan crafted recovery mix tailored for me! 
Prepared for whatever mission threw her way...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Tannhauser-chan, won't let your efforts go to waste! 
I'll conquer this mountain and close gap!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaa~... Fixed chain and it slipped off again... 
What do I do? What do I do? ...*whimper*~...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Still, must push on... Top Road-san is waiting for me...! 
Until the finish line... to very end... I must~!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Who will emerge first at 3rd transition 
where anchors wait?! Cheers roar louder and louder! 
Leading the charge is—

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O! Unbelievable, Sakura Bakushin O takes lead! 
Mejiro Ryan and Meisho Doto pursuing from behind!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Baku-shin... Baku-shin...! Bakushin... Shiiin—!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... No pedaling required on downhill slope...! 
Stamina preserved flawlessly...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Coasting downhill without pedaling... Ah! Unicycle drills! 
So that's what that practice was for!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Nah, just felt like riding unicycle, but worked out great! 
Keep rolling, Bakushin O—!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Conquered dreaded long-distance route 
everyone worried about through sheer determination!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No barrier class president cannot overcome—! Bakushin, Bakushin, 
Bakushin, Bakushin, Bakushiiin—!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ryan-san—! Keep fighting, mun—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Legs feel lighter than ever...! 
Time for final all-out sprint!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ryan Onee-sama—!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: *sob*, Top Road-san~! *sniff*, *whimper*, waaaah~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Doto-chan! You're doing great! Almost there!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Leader Sakura Bakushin O passes baton 
to Kitasan Black while maintaining first place!
